description: Threshold-tuning set for RAG_MIN_SCORE (v1.0). NOT part of the frozen golden set (rag_golden.json v1.0): the threshold is chosen on this set and the golden set only confirms it. Same schema as the golden set. in_scope topics are MedlinePlus titles that do not appear in the golden set; near_miss and off_topic are questions the knowledge base must not answer. No hard negatives (their page exists, so no threshold can refuse them). t33 and t34 are terse or colloquial on purpose, so the threshold is not tuned only on clean sentences. t34 is retrieval-only (see its note).
